WithRows.note: Mono uppercase eyebrow (AGENT DEFAULTS) over a flat stack of three SettingsRows with Select and Switch controls. No card box, structure comes from the eyebrow plus the rows' hairlines — exactly the component's documented anatomy.

WithAction.note: Header line with title, description and a right-aligned 'Add secret' Button in the action slot, baseline-aligned with the eyebrow. Secret rows below carry status badges.

StackedSections.note: Two sections in one gap-8 stack (Notifications, Danger zone) showing that section spacing is the parent's job. Destructive Button renders in DS red; both eyebrows and the second section's description read correctly.

TitleOnly.note: Title without description — the header collapses to just the eyebrow, which is the variant this cell is for. Shortcut badges give the rows realistic trailing content.
